title: Topological model for a Cremer Julia set
exact_target: Describe a plausible topological model of the Julia set of a quadratic Cremer polynomial.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 5300027 (AMR-052-0027). CC BY 4.0.
